out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: PIC was not aware that an Employee Health Policy/Employee Illness Agreement was in place. Observed no signed copy for PIC.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. PIC FOUND BLANK COPIES THE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY. PIC SIGNED ONE DURING THE INSPECTION. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO HAVE ALL CURRENT EMPLOYEES READ AND SIGN A COPY. RETAIN FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

violations.title: Food from Approved Source
violations.observation: The following food items were observed in home-style packaging: 1) candied nuts 2) various jams and preserves in mason jars PIC could not produce invoices for these products
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with the Law. PIC AGREED TO NOT SELL THESE PRODUCTS. PIC TOOK PRODUCTS DOWN FROM RETAIL SALE AREA. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO ONLY PURCHASE FOOD FROM APPROVED SOURCES. FOOD PRODUCED UNDER COTTAGE LAW CANNOT BE SOLD IN A PERMITTED FOOD ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) gallon of milk was dated for October 15
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE MILK.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the hot water at the 3-compartment sink was observed at 102f.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. HOT WATER AT THE 3-COMPARTMENT SINK NEEDS TO BE A MINIMUM OF 110F. ADJUST AND CORRECT TEMPERATURE BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) speed rack 2) exterior of ice cream cooler around hot water well 3) cooler handles
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the floors throughout the kitchen and dining area with an accumulation of food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. Great Falls Creamery (Inspection Date: 10/29/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed multiple spray bottles of sanitizer being stored on a shelf with food equipment
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED SANITIZER BOTTLES NEXT TO THE TRASH CAN AWAY FOR FOOD EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The basin of the small white hand sink was observed draining slow
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE.
